concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-adobe-commerce-set-up-adyen-customer-area]] — 2024-modified Adobe Commerce Customer Area setup guide captured 2026-09-15: v8.4+ automated versus manual setup, credential/webhook/HMAC and capture-delay instructions, with reconfiguration-loss and v8/v9 endpoint qualifications.
warnings: Automated setup from plugin v8.4.0 can overwrite an older configuration; do not collapse it into the manual path or assume the exact GitHub v11 baseline uses identical setup behavior.
Webhook URL differs for v8 and v9+, and HMAC/Basic-auth instructions are configuration requirements, not delivered-webhook proof.
The source does not verify actual Customer Area role grants, installed credential values, live readiness, capture success or payment settlement.
